user.title: ABB Welcome
user.description: Select your ABB Welcome device type.

ip_gateway.title: ABB Welcome IP Gateway
ip_gateway.description:
Pair this Home Assistant instance with your ABB Welcome IP gateway.

Required fields:
• MyBuildings portal username and password (same as the official ABB Welcome mobile app).
• Gateway local IP address.
• Gateway web admin password (the one used at https://gateway-ip/).

Optional:
• Gateway Portal UUID — only fill this in if the automatic setup fails (some firmware versions have a broken portal-client endpoint). You can find this value in the gateway web admin under the Portal page (label “Portal Client UUID”), or in the ABB Welcome mobile app settings. Leave blank otherwise.

After you submit, the integration finishes pairing automatically — no need to open the gateway web admin yourself.

wifi_panel.title: ABB Welcome 4.3 WiFi Panel
wifi_panel.description:
Pair this Home Assistant instance with your ABB Welcome 4.3 WiFi panel (experimental).

The WiFi panel has no web admin interface. Pairing is completed on the panel's touchscreen.

Required fields:
• MyBuildings portal username and password (same as the official ABB Welcome mobile app).
• WiFi panel local IP address.

Optional:
• Gateway Portal UUID — only fill this in if the automatic discovery fails. You can find this value in the ABB Welcome mobile app settings or in the panel's system settings. Leave blank to auto-detect.

After you submit, the integration will send a pairing request. You will then need to approve it on the WiFi panel touchscreen.

wifi_approve.title: Approve pairing on the WiFi panel
wifi_approve.description:
A pairing request has been sent to your ABB Welcome WiFi panel at {gateway_ip}.

Please approve the pairing on the panel touchscreen:

1. On the WiFi panel, go to **System Settings** → **APP Settings**.
2. Find the pending app named:

    **{client_name}**

3. Select it and enter the integrity code when prompted:

    **{integrity_code}**

4. Confirm / Approve on the panel.
5. Click **Submit** below to continue.

Home Assistant will wait up to 5 minutes for the panel to confirm the pairing.

manual_authorize.title: Approve pairing on the gateway
manual_authorize.description:
Auto-approval failed, but the pairing request was sent successfully and is waiting on your gateway. Please finish the approval manually:

1. Open https://{gateway_ip}/ in a browser and log in as `admin`.
2. Navigate to the **Portal / Portal Client** page.
3. Find the pending app named:

    **{client_name}**

4. When prompted for an integrity code, enter:

    **{integrity_code}**

5. Confirm / Approve in the gateway UI.
6. Click **Submit** below to continue.

Home Assistant will wait up to 5 minutes for the gateway to confirm the pairing.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway web admin on HTTPS port 443. Check the IP address and that Home Assistant is on the same network.
error.gateway_not_found: No gateway is visible to this portal account. If using a WiFi panel, ensure the panel is connected to MyBuildings.
error.gateway_admin_auth_failed: Gateway admin password is wrong (login at https://gateway-ip/ as `admin` failed).
error.no_pending_app: The gateway did not see our pairing request. Try again or check that the portal account is linked to this gateway.
error.integrity_code_rejected: The gateway rejected the integrity code we computed. Open an issue with your gateway firmware version.
error.gateway_admin_failed: Talking to the gateway admin CGI failed — see the Home Assistant log.
error.gateway_op6_failed: Could not read the gateway's portal UUID. Some firmware versions have a broken portal-client endpoint. Fill in the optional 'Gateway Portal UUID' field and try again.
error.invalid_uuid: Gateway Portal UUID must look like 8d24f178-9c41-4aed-97e1-6008bb6aef82 (8-4-4-4-12 hex). Leave blank to auto-detect.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — see the Home Assistant log.

abort.acl_timeout: The device did not push a configuration after pairing. Try again. If using a WiFi panel, make sure you approved the pairing on the panel touchscreen.
abort.acl_parse_failed: The device sent a configuration but it could not be parsed. Check the Home Assistant log.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error during ACL polling — see the Home Assistant log.
